name: The implementing agent's work
blurb: one document per plan he accepted; it carries out and reports back

groups.label: bucket
groups.note: the bucket of the task the plan was about, not the day it was accepted

owner_legacy.note: the two agents were renamed on 12 Sep 2026 — night-agent for the hour it ran, execution-agent for the job, onto one axis as planning-agent and implementing-agent. core/migrations/migrate-agent-names.py rewrites what is on disk; this is what reads a document that migration never reached, such as one restored from a backup.

hints.Backlog: accepted, and the agent leaves it alone until you move it
hints.To do: you want the implementing agent to carry this one out
hints.Doing: the agent has it right now
hints.Waiting for review: it did the work and wrote back; it is waiting on you
hints.Done: you have accepted what it did

fields.note: the plan this run carries out, as <night>/<file.md>
the title of the task as it stood when the plan was accepted
one line; the plan's own summary until the agent replaces it with what it did
the session the implementing agent ran in, so the work can be read back
